evaluation_plan.decision: suggestion only; a status change is an owner's transition() call
evaluation_plan.evidence_source: scripts/shadow/arm_report.py deviation_signal, one per week, future window only
evaluation_plan.hybrid: HYBRID_30_DATA reported as derived (0.3 x DATA_ONLY deviation), never counted
evaluation_plan.hypothesis: when |DATA_ONLY margin - snapshot market margin| >= 1.0 point, the market margin moves toward DATA_ONLY by the close
evaluation_plan.metric: toward rate = toward / (toward + away) among games with a meaningful deviation
evaluation_plan.unit: one game per horizon view (a game counts once per horizon, never once per snapshot or contract)

GAME_CENTRE_DEVIATION.arm: DATA_ONLY (primary). HYBRID_30_DATA is reported as derived: 0.3 x DATA_ONLY deviation, not independent
GAME_CENTRE_DEVIATION.denominator: toward + away only; unchanged (the market did not move) and no_close (no valid closing centre) are shown separately and are never in the denominator
GAME_CENTRE_DEVIATION.not_supported_suggestion: multiplicity-adjusted Wilson upper bound < 0.5, OR the toward rate is below 0.5 with at least min_directional_observations
GAME_CENTRE_DEVIATION.supported_suggestion: multiplicity-adjusted Wilson lower bound of the toward rate > 0.5

trend.effect: toward_rate - 0.5, compared with the generation window's toward_rate - 0.5

GAME_CENTRE_DEVIATION.unit: one game per horizon view (a game counts once per horizon, never once per snapshot or contract)

LOCALIZED_SLICE.metric: model_minus_market_brier, game-clustered SE, synchronized PROSPECTIVE_FROZEN rows only
LOCALIZED_SLICE.not_supported_suggestion: the CI excludes 0 on the opposite side, OR the sign is reversed with at least min_new_independent_games new games
LOCALIZED_SLICE.supported_suggestion: the multiplicity-adjusted CI of model-minus-market Brier excludes 0 on the generation effect's side AND the future effect has the generation effect's sign AND, for a model-beats-market hypothesis, mean CLV (mid, toward model) >= 0 (missing CLV -> INCONCLUSIVE)

labels.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than min_new_independent_games new games, or no estimate

multiple_comparisons.family: every registered hypothesis in PREREGISTERED or TESTING status at evaluation time
multiple_comparisons.note: the per-hypothesis alpha is 0.05 / m, m = hypotheses under test; an interval used for a suggestion is widened to that level (at m = 1 it is the ordinary 95% interval). Holm's step-down is no less strict at its first rejection; Bonferroni is used because a suggestion is read one hypothesis at a time. Secondary horizons, HYBRID (a derived arm) and GENERATED-only slices are descriptive and are not members of the family.
